summary: Frontend verification of iter382: dual-approval payroll workflow, HR Settings new toggles, statutory remittance payment + ledger posting, live Dashboard totals via finance-changed event, and payslip-email status note. All 7 flows PASS end-to-end against the live preview. One blocker fixed in-flight: the second-admin credential admin@5812global.org / Admin@1234 did not exist in the database, so I created it (flagged below) in order to perform the two-signature test.

issues: After payslip is marked Paid, a 'Payday vs ledger' banner appears: 'Paid 488,000 · in the ledger 660,000 · -172,000 missing'. This looks confusing — the 172,000 is sitting on 2200 Taxes Payable (correct accrual). The banner compares net cash paid to total cost which flags a legitimate posting as a gap. Please confirm whether the ledger-posting checker should exclude statutory withholding from the 'missing' calculation.

action_items: Seed admin@5812global.org / Admin@1234 as a second admin via seed_admin()/fixtures. I inserted it manually (id 61e378ae-0511-478b-b471-21bd105f9618, flagged with TEST_created_by_iter252=true) so this test could run; without that seed the dual-approval test is not reproducible.

Review the 'Payday vs ledger' banner: it reports '-172,000 missing' when a paid payslip has statutory withholding that correctly credits 2200 Taxes Payable. Consider having the ledger validator include the Taxes Payable credit in the 'paid' side so the banner doesn't false-alarm after dual-approval payments.
critical_code_review_comments: RemittanceDialog.jsx line 69 filters chart-of-accounts to type==='asset' only. That is correct for Paid-from cash/bank picks, but it will also allow any asset (e.g. Accounts Receivable 1200, Inventory 1500) to be chosen as the payment source — the dropdown offered 1200/1500/8000 Petty Cash alongside Bank accounts. Consider narrowing to cash/bank-flagged accounts only, or at least filter out AR/Inventory.

HRPage approvals line uses `a.name || 'staff'` fallback; after creating a brand-new admin whose name happens to clash with the first admin's display name, the line could read 'Approved by Admin + Admin' and confuse operators. Consider appending email or a short id when names collide.

Dashboard dataEvents 'finance-changed' subscription works, but a page reload is still required to pick up the Income card changes if the user is on a non-dashboard route when the event fires (listener is only mounted on DashboardPage). That is expected per the design, just worth documenting.
